# PiliPlus television play icon

`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/ic_pili_tv_play.png` is an unmodified copy of
`assets/images/play.png` from PiliPlus (https://github.com/bggRGjQaUbCoE/PiliPlus),
local source revision `1c19925b58c62ee131051c2eb5ac8f1f2660e582`.

Upstream project license: GNU General Public License v3.0. See
[piliplus-LICENSE.txt](piliplus-LICENSE.txt) for the bundled upstream license.

The player cover uses the original 60dp icon size; dynamic video cards use 50dp.
The original alpha mask is tinted at render time with the current theme primary color.
